== Biography ==
William, possibly of Scotland, was previously listed as born 1667 - more reasonable circa 1649, assuming that he is the correct father of the attached daughter.  He passed away in 1725, Henrico County, Virginia Colony, an area later known as Chesterfield County.

== Research Notes ==
* Family records. This cannot be a source without definitive descriptive information. Chesterfield as a location did not exist until later. The area Chesterfield was formed out of Henrico County.

* Rule out any alignment with this CPT William Mitchell (circa 1667-1725); however, his birth is reportedly Swift Creek, Henrico County. Thom King, "Family Tree King", [unsourced] database, Genealogy Online (https://www.genealogieonline.nl/family-tree-king/P1055.php : accessed July 4, 2026), "William Mitchell CPT (1667-1725)".

A possible identification concerns William Mitchell. The printed Edinburgh marriage register records Jean Glasgow with William Mitchell, merchant, on 16 December 1675.<ref>Scotland’s People: Old Parish Registers — banns and marriages: OPR 685 / 1/440 / 164; [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ record]; Henry Paton, ed., Register of Marriages for the Parish of Edinburgh, 1595–1700 (Scottish Record Society, 1905), printed pp.267 and 481; PDF pp.277 and 491; [https://electricscotland.com/history/records/scottishrecordso16scotuoft.pdf#page=491 record]; Same edition, unnumbered Prefatory Note, PDF p.9; [https://electricscotland.com/history/records/scottishrecordso16scotuoft.pdf#page=9 record].</ref> The printed transcription and its preface were visually inspected on 30 September 2026; original parish image unchecked. The identification remains uncertain.
